Supply exactly one nonempty primary identifier. Enrichment may discover
additional pointers for the stored row; the submitted identifier wins.

pubkey_b64.description: Base64 of the 32-byte ed25519 public key.

key.description: Full plaintext key. Shown only in the create response.

Asset kinds from design §12.3. Serialized snake_case on the wire and as
the `kind` TEXT column value.

name.description: Display name for the minted key (default "cli").

verifier.description: PKCE verifier whose sha256 hex must equal the challenge from /start.

version.description: Workspace version these artifacts were built from (matches /health).

sha256_url.description: Sidecar file containing the artifact's SHA-256 (hex).

commit_sha.description:
Required alongside `repo_url`; omitted for platform-hosted papers
(pinned later once code is pushed).

repo_url.description:
External repo pointer. Omit to have the platform provision a repo on
the dedicated Gitea instance (requires the integration to be configured).

agent_id.description: Attribute the environment to one of the caller's agents (optional).

profile.description: Free-form environment descriptor: gpu, os, cpu, deps fingerprint, …

slug.description:
Creator-unique slug (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$`); derived from `title`
when omitted.

secret.description: HMAC secret the receiver uses to verify `X-Automl-Signature`.

body.description: Optional first post (markdown), created atomically with the thread.

ImportPdfRequest.description:
P2 PDF intake (design §12.2 path 4): the document registers as a DaaS
DocumentAsset inside the bound workspace, and the returned
`daas_document_id` lands on the fuel shelf via the normal add path —
member recheck and `paper.added` audit included.

With `StubDaaS` (no `DAAS_API_BASE` configured) the document id is a
synthetic `stub-doc-*` value. A caller that already holds a
`daas_document_id` can pass it directly and skip the upstream call.
A live upstream failure is an honest 503, never a fake id.

daas_document_id.description: Pre-registered DocumentAsset id — skips the upstream import call.

title.description:
Human label for the document; sent to DaaS and cached as the shelf
entry's display title when enrichment provides none.

uri.description: Optional source URI the client already uploaded elsewhere.

PageProjectAsset.description: OpenAPI shape of the shared pagination envelope.

PageProjectPaper.description: OpenAPI shape of the shared pagination envelope.

commit_sha.description:
Author-pinned commit used for reproduction. `""` = not pinned yet
(platform-hosted paper before the first pin).

latest_commit.description: Last commit observed on the dedicated Gitea via push webhook.

provider.description: Downstream provider; only `w_daas` exists in P2.

verified.description: True when the provider confirmed the workspace exists at bind time.

agent_name.description: Reserved for legacy agent rows; agent authorization is not supported in P0.

principal_type.description: `scholar` (agent ACL enrollment is deferred in P0).

ProjectRole.description: Project roles ordered Viewer < Member < Owner (§12.1).

persist.description: Persist the outcome as a `search_snapshot` asset (Member+ only).

snapshot_asset_id.description: Set when `persist: true` — the created `search_snapshot` asset.

ProjectStatus.description:
Lifecycle: `draft → active → archived`; each live state may soft-delete
to `deleted` (§12.1). Only deleted is terminal; archived cannot unarchive.

ProjectView.description:
Member responses retain the full project DTO; public nonmember responses
use the deliberately narrow metadata allowlist below.

ProjectVisibility.description:
`private` = members only. `lab` is reserved for the (future) lab/org concept
and behaves as members-only until labs exist. `public_meta` exposes project
an explicit metadata allowlist to authenticated principals with projects:read.

pubkey.description: Base64 or hex encoding of a 32-byte ed25519 public key.

content_hash.description:
SHA-256 hex of reproduce.yaml bytes (client-side). Combined with the
paper's pinned commit_sha into `spec_hash`.

lab_id.description: Reserved lab/org pointer (P0 stub — no lab table yet).

w_daas_workspace_id.description: Unverified external workspace pointer; no access grant or downstream call.

signature_hex.description:
ed25519 signature over the canonical evidence payload (hex).
Required together with `signer_key_id` for verified-by-N credit.

signer_key_id.description: Registered `agent_devices.id` that holds the verifying public key.

bearer_api_key.description: API key issued by POST /api/v1/keys. Header: Authorization: Bearer amk_…

get.summary:
Fleet-standard health envelope. Always 200; `status` in the body carries
the truth (`ok` / `degraded`) so load balancers keep routing while humans
and Radar see the degradation.

delete.summary: Revoke a key. Idempotent for already-revoked keys owned by the caller.
